sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 77 (Maurist text and numbering, Sainte-Marthe 1705), from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Ph. Roelli (2013), as on Latin Wikisource
sources.description: Latin letters matched to the English by book and letter number (Maurist numbering, the same as NPNF), all 420. 409 come from Latin Wikisource and 11 (XIII.18, 22, 26, 27, 31, 34, 38-42) from the Corpus Corporum TEI of PL 77 (text 8064, https://mlat.uzh.ch/php_modules/download.php?type=file-xml&idno=8064), because the Wikisource page for Book XIII stops in the middle of letter 15. Each file keeps the Maurist summary and address; PL column numbers and markup removed; the editors' bracketed textual notes kept in the Wikisource letters. The Maurist footnotes are not included. The Register has about 430 further Latin letters that NPNF does not translate; they are not imported here.
sources.tierEvidence: Text of a 6th-century work in the Maurist edition (1705, Migne 1849), long public domain; Corpus Corporum TEI is a transcription.

sources.description: Translated by James Barmby. From Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Vols. 12-13, Edited by Philip Schaff and Henry Wace, Buffalo, NY: Christian Literature Publishing Co 1895. Revised and edited for New Advent by Kevin Knight.
